about_the_game:
🧠 About This Application

LocalHelper.ai is your private, voice-enabled AI assistant for home and office — running entirely on your own computer, without sending anything to the cloud.

It helps you stay productive, get quick answers, control your devices (coming soon), and manage everyday tasks — all through natural voice or text interaction. You stay in control: your data never leaves your PC.

🚀 Early Access

LocalHelper is currently in Early Access, and some features are still limited. The core experience is fully functional, but we're actively expanding capabilities based on user feedback.

You can help shape the future of LocalHelper by suggesting or voting on new features on our forum or directly from the program menu!

✨ Key Features

  • 🗣️ Talk or type — your assistant listens and responds naturally

  • 🔒 100% offline operation — your data stays private

  • 🧠 Helps with daily tasks: answers, summaries, and more

  • 💡 Continuously evolving with community-driven updates

  • 📎 Lightweight and easy to run — no subscriptions or accounts required

LocalHelper is ideal for privacy-conscious users, remote workers, or anyone who wants an AI assistant without giving up control of their personal data.

content_descriptors.notes: This product includes a voice/text AI assistant that responds freely to user prompts. While it does not contain built-in sexual or violent content, the AI may generate responses that involve adult themes — such as sexual language, suggestive dialogue, or mature discussions — depending on the user's input. The developer does not promote or encourage such use.

name: LocalHelper.AI

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 30xx GPU with 8 GB VRAM with latest drivers
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device; USB or built-in audio interface
  • Additional Notes: Microphone with good sensitivity and clarity required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 or better (8 GB+ VRAM recommended)
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High-quality onboard audio or dedicated USB audio interface
  • Additional Notes: Use of high-quality condenser microphone and quiet environment strongly improves voice interaction

short_description: 🧠 Your private AI assistant — control your PC with voice or text, manage tasks, and boost productivity. 🔒 100% offline — no internet, no accounts, no tracking. 🚀 In Early Access — suggest features and shape the future of LocalHelper on our forum!
